caption:
A simple way to get more from the walks you already do.

It was developed by researchers at Shinshu University. In their studies, middle-aged and older adults who did it regularly for a few months improved their fitness and leg strength more than people who walked at an even pace.

Three minutes fast, three minutes slow, five rounds. You can do it on a lunch break or round the block after tea.

Save this for your next walk, and send it to the friend you'd do it with.

#JapaneseWalking #WalkingUK #FitnessOver40 #MoveMore #UKWellness
